newsitem.title: MOROCCO: FORECAST-Morocco sees 96 GDP growth at 10.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Morocco sees 96 GDP growth at 10.3 pct.

text.p: Moroccco's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is forecast to grow 10.3 percent this year against 1995 but the figure needed to be interpreted with caution because of the heavy fall last year, the Statistics Directorate said on Monday.
"This level must be considered with prudence since 1995 recorded a very heavy fall of more than 7.0 percent," it said.
According Bank al-Magrib (central bank), Morocco's GDP was 276.9 billion dirhams in 1995, down from 279.3 billion dirhams in 1994.
"Thus if the GDP level for 1996 is compared with that of 1994, the level of variation scarcely attains two percent," the directorate said.
